style: Original instrumental adventure-game score. Chamber orchestra with warm woodwinds, harp, strings, light hand percussion, and touches of koto and shinobue. Modal harmony, a clear restrained melody, sincere and slightly wistful, no bombast, no trailer drums, no choir, no vocals, no lyrics. Full-length eight-minute arrangement with a slow introduction, a gently developing middle, and a quiet settled ending.
negative: vocals, lyrics, choir, spoken word, rap, EDM drop, trailer drums, distorted electric guitar, saxophone solo, cheesy synth lead
